record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: For each of the three integrable N = 2 super KdV equations SKdV_a with a = -2, 1, and 4, can one find an integrable Gardner-type deformation whose conserved quantities reproduce the infinite tower of conservation laws generated from the corresponding Lax formulation?

evidence.quote: Although there exists a Miura transformation, there are no known integrable (i.e., Gardner-type) deformations of it. This leads us to: OP-2: Find an integrable deformation for SKdV−2,1,4 that reproduces their conservations laws.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the three integrable N=2 supersymmetric Korteweg–de Vries equations on a (1|2)-dimensional superspace with bosonic coordinate x, time t, and odd coordinates θ_1, θ_2. Let D_i = ∂/∂θ_i + θ_i ∂/∂x (i=1,2) be the standard super-derivatives and let Φ(x,t;θ_1,θ_2) be an N=2 bosonic superfield. The N=2 SKdV family is

  Φ_t = −Φ_xxx + 3(Φ D_1 D_2 Φ)_x + ((a−1)/2)(D_1 D_2 Φ^2)_x + 3a Φ^2 Φ_x,

which is known to be integrable (admitting a Lax representation and infinitely many conserved quantities) only for a ∈ {−2, 1, 4}.

A Gardner-type deformation of an evolution system u_t = F[u] is, by definition, a one-parameter family of evolution systems ũ_t = F̃[ũ; ε] together with an ε-dependent Miura-type transformation u = M(ũ; ε) such that the expansion of the conserved densities of the deformed system in powers of ε produces, recursively, the infinite tower of conserved densities of the original system.

Problem: For each of the three values a ∈ {−2, 1, 4}, determine whether there exists an integrable Gardner-type deformation of the N=2 SKdV_a equation whose induced recursion of conserved densities reproduces the infinite hierarchy of conservation laws coming from the Lax formulation of SKdV_a.
artifact.status_search_result: The a=4 case has been resolved: Hussin, Kiselev, Krutov and Wolf solved the Gardner deformation problem for N=2 SKdV with a=4 via a two-step scheme involving a new Gardner deformation of the Kaup–Boussinesq equation in the bosonic limit (J. Math. Phys. 51, 083507 (2010); arXiv:0911.2681 and arXiv:1108.2211). Analogous deformations for the a=−2 and a=1 cases do not appear to have been constructed in the literature, so the problem in its full generality is only partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Gardner's deformations of the N=2 supersymmetric a=4-KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: Two-step scheme producing recursion for super-Hamiltonians of the N=2, a=4 SKdV hierarchy via a new Gardner deformation of the Kaup–Boussinesq equation.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a Gardner-type deformation reproducing the conservation laws for the a=4 case.

status_evidence.title: Gardner's deformations of the graded Korteweg–de Vries equations revisited
status_evidence.snippet: We solve the Gardner deformation problem for the N=2 supersymmetric a=4 Korteweg–de Vries equation.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms resolution of the a=4 case; a=-2 and a=1 cases not addressed.
